integrity: Formal proofs of the structural rank lemma, positive recurrence, and asymptotic tail bounds appear in RESULT.md; exhaustive checker logs support only finite instances.
scientific_limitations: All-parameter theorem counts Jordan partitions for the cover-supported subspace of the radical acting on the canonical incidence module; full-radical conclusion is only maximal nilpotency index. It does not classify full-radical Jordan types or prove publication priority. The critical percolation threshold is classical. Independent audit not performed.
title: Jordan-type census and a critical nilpotency window for rooted-tree incidence radicals
